Our Corporate Governance Guidelines, which are available at www.eogresources.com/company/board-of-directors, mandate that:
● at least three-fifths of our directors must meet the criteria for independence required by the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE"), the SEC, and our bylaws; and
● no non-employee director may serve on the board of directors of more than four other public companies, and our CEO may not serve on the board of directors of more than two other public companies.
In assessing director independence, the Board considered, among other matters, the nature and extent of any business relationships, including any transactions conducted, between
EOG and an immediate family member of a director, and
EOG and any organization for which one of our directors or an immediate family member is a director, executive officer or is otherwise affiliated.
